NASA’s Voyager 1 just made history by reaching one light-day from Earth, over sixteen billion miles away. But what if this famous probe slammed into a hidden icy planet lurking in the dark outer solar system? Traveling at thirty-eight thousand miles per hour, the impact would instantly vaporize Voyager’s metallic body. Its plutonium power source would scatter across frozen alien ground, leaving the iconic Golden Record buried on a silent world forever. Would you send another probe to search for it? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: NASA’s Voyager 1 Makes History Reaching One Light-Day from Earth - NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) (.gov)
